method: For each tracked text worktree path reported as CRLF or mixed, replace CRLF and bare CR bytes with LF; before writing, require the resulting Git blob to equal that path's HEAD blob. No decoding or content edits.
limitations: Windows working-tree result only; clean Node22/Ubuntu CI is a separate B07.01 gate.
Historical browser sidecars that fingerprint current behavior remain stale when non-EOL source changed; EOL normalization does not rewrite their embedded results.
